model.name: UAV blade antenna (867 MHz)
model.description: Swept metal blade monopole on a 300 x 300 mm fuselage-skin ground plane, fed by a 50 ohm probe across a 2 mm gap at its base (x: flight axis, +x aft; z: up). A vertically polarised, azimuth-omnidirectional UAV telemetry antenna for the 863-870 MHz SRD / LoRa band; h = 80 mm gives |S11| about -23 dB at 867 MHz and a -10 dB band of about 0.75-1.8 GHz. See examples/designs/README.md in the fairbeam repository.
